summary.text: Jessica Van Oort is a Democratic and Vermont Progressive Party candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Rutland-Bennington District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner who serves on the Pawlet Selectboard.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Van Oort wrote in a Ballotpedia survey that she is involved with the community garden and the food pantry and that her first work as a public servant was on the Pawlet Planning Commission.

She said she became involved in local government during the pandemic and cited helping bring high-speed internet to every part of Pawlet, streamlining local zoning, and obtaining a grant for geothermal heating and cooling in town buildings.
She also said she taught for some years in the performing arts department of a small college.
Van Oort listed fair taxes, a state law revoking corporations' right to make political donations, and regulation of data centers as key campaign messages.
She wrote that she supports sensible, balanced updates to Act 250 and named the environment, education and the arts among her policy interests.
